pages.title: One More Step
pages.text: Successfully use Demolition Leap or a compatible Meteor Slam.

pages.title: One More Step
pages.text: Add a deliberate combat movement technique with its own cost.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Learn a suitable skill, equip compatible gear and check its cost. Extra jumping, a charged leap and a descending slam are different actions; dangerous-height jumps are not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Demolition Leap uses charge and Meteor Slam requires its compatible slam context. Phantom Ascent adds a jump but does not count for this goal. Revelation has separate conditions.
